title: Central Plant Water Sampling — Storage Tank and City Line

lines.msg: Storage tank, sample 07:00 (before fill valve closed): total chlorine 3.6 mg/L, turbidity 0.3 NTU, no coliform detected.
Storage tank, sample 08:30: total chlorine 3.5 mg/L, turbidity 0.3 NTU.
City fill line at the tank inlet, flushed 07:05: total chlorine 4.4 mg/L, turbidity 4.1 NTU.
Samples are held for the health department laboratory; field kit results only.

instructorNote: This log confirms the stored water remains uncontaminated, but the city line shows high chlorine and turbidity. The field kit is not a lab result, so no action should be taken to resume use of the stored water. The samples must be submitted to the health department via EMA.
